maddeler.e:
استقوا (form VIII)
# اِسْتَقَوْا (istaqaw) /is.ta.qaw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَقَى (istaqā)
# اُسْتُقُوا (ustuqū) /us.tu.quː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَقَى (istaqā)
# اِسْتَقُوا (istaqū) /is.ta.quː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَقَى (istaqā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
